orchestrator_adjudication: Headline sandbox-egress DOWNGRADED critical->high: VERIFIED manifest.config.ts:54-55 sandbox CSP has no connect-src, and new Function runs in the iframe realm so fetch/XHR/DOM are reachable. Kept high not critical: the script under test is user-supplied (loaded BR or paste) or LLM-generated in-app — the user could run the same fetch() in their own console, so no privilege boundary is crossed they couldn't cross themselves. BUT must-fix: 'sandbox' naming + real seeded instance data + LLM-generated scripts running here make egress containment a legitimate expectation, and the fix is ~1 CSP token. Prototype-pollution-to-host confirmed NOT possible (iframe has independent realm); cross-job contamination in a reused frame is real (separate medium).

findings.description: runSimulation runs user/LLM script via new Function in the sandboxed iframe's own realm; only scope names (current/previous/gs/...) are shadowed. fetch/XMLHttpRequest/WebSocket/document/location remain reachable. A script can POST the seeded real-instance record data or the script body to an external host, invisible to the write-blocked trace. Sandbox CSP (manifest.config.ts:55) sets no connect-src/navigate-to, so egress is not policy-blocked either. (Reviewer rated critical.)
findings.suggested_fix: Add connect-src 'none'; navigate-to 'none' to the sandbox CSP; optionally delete/override fetch/XHR/WebSocket/navigation on the sandbox window before each run. Document that 'zero instance risk' means 'no GlideRecord writes', not 'no egress', until fixed.

findings.description: When the same GlideRecord var name is re-declared, the inner queryRe.exec searches the WHOLE script per declaration instead of scoping to the region after that declaration. (a) a genuinely unconditioned 2nd query inherits hasFilter=true from the 1st unrelated addQuery -> false negative; (b) code.slice(laterDecl, earlierQuery) is '' (start>end) -> already-filtered 1st query misreported as unconditioned -> false positive.
findings.suggested_fix: Scope each declaration's query window to [d.index, nextDeclIndexOrEnd).

findings.description: Readiness handshake has no timeout; run() awaits ensure() before starting its own timer. If the iframe never posts sncat:sim:ready (bad build, CSP violation, throw before ready), every run() hangs forever; this.ready is memoized so the hang is sticky across all future runs — Run button spins with no error/recovery short of page reload.
findings.suggested_fix: Separate readiness-wait timeout that rejects and resets frame/ready to null so a later call reprovisions a fresh iframe.

findings.description: Sandbox message listener accepts any data.kind==='sncat:sim:run' and replies to ev.source with no origin/source check. Any script obtaining a handle to the iframe (future embed, or XSS in host page) could submit jobs bypassing SandboxRunner lifecycle. Combined with the egress finding, another path to the same capability.
findings.suggested_fix: Pin ev.source from the first legitimate message / handshake; at minimum require ev.source===window.parent.

findings.description: Iframe (and its realm) reused across successful runs; only destroyed on timeout. A script mutating shared built-ins (Array.prototype.push=..., override JSON.stringify) persists and corrupts the NEXT run in that frame, with nothing in the trace indicating a prior-script cause. Does NOT cross into host realm.
findings.suggested_fix: Recreate iframe per job, or snapshot/restore the built-ins the mocks/engine rely on before each run.

findings.description: stripComments blanks comments but leaves string-literal contents intact; every rule except ruleHardcodedSysId can false-positive on pattern-shaped text inside strings, e.g. gs.addErrorMessage("...current.update()...") in a before-BR reports update-in-before-br. Contradicts 'string-aware' intent.
findings.suggested_fix: Blank string-literal spans too (offset-preserving), keeping a separate string-content-aware pass for ruleHardcodedSysId.

findings.description: catch assumes Error: error=(err as Error).message. throw 'str' / throw {} yields undefined, violating the string TraceEvent contract; UI shows 'undefined' or throws.
findings.suggested_fix: error = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err).

findings.description: getValue/getDisplayValue read the same fields map; reference fields (value=sys_id, display=name) simulate identically. Script branching on getDisplayValue('caller_id')=='VIP' evaluates against the seeded sys_id -> wrong branch vs real instance.
findings.suggested_fix: Optional display-value map per field on SimulationJob, or trace-warn when getDisplayValue is called on a sys_id-looking seeded value.

findings.description: No queue/serialization across concurrent run() on one runner. jobB queued behind a slow/hung jobA in the single-thread iframe; jobB's own timer can fire and misattribute a timeout to jobB. Hit if UI allows a 2nd Run before the 1st finishes or two hosts share one runner (handoff '3+1' UX).
findings.suggested_fix: Serialize/queue run() calls, or reject a new run() with 'simulation already in progress' while one is outstanding.

findings.description: get/next/hasNext hard-stubbed false (known deferred milestone). Any logic gated on a successful lookup always takes not-found branch; trace doesn't distinguish 'stubbed false' from 'genuinely no rows' -> user may misread as a real negative result.
findings.suggested_fix: Caption get/next/hasNext results in trace/UI as 'always false in this milestone' until read-through lands.

findings.description: lineDiff('','x'): ''.split('\n') yields [''] not [], so diffing empty prior content emits a spurious {op:'del',text:''}.

const GlideRecordSecure = GlideRecord placeholder gives scoped scripts unrestricted semantics (canRead/Write/Create always true) with no trace signal that ACLs weren't modeled — 'no ACL errors' can be over-trusted.
findings.suggested_fix: Track ticket + surface a SimulationResult.note when GlideRecordSecure is actually invoked.

perf: No findings (lineAt O(n) rescan, diff O(n*m) DP both proportional to small script sizes).
purpose_notes_condensed: stripComments: offset-preserving comment blanking for accurate line numbers; tracks (not blanks) strings only to avoid //-in-string false comment starts — root of the string-awareness gap.
ruleUnconditionedQuery: per-variable-name query check (sound in spirit, mis-scoped on name reuse).
runSimulation: single Layer-2 entry; assembles mocks, runs via new Function, always returns structured SimulationResult; pure/DOM-free so it runs in both iframe and Vitest.
createRecordProxy: Proxy over in-memory field map (emits field-set on change) + method table; backs current/previous/ad-hoc via options bag.
GlideRecordSecure: distinct name so scoped scripts don't ReferenceError; bare alias placeholder for ACL-aware pass.
SandboxRunner.ensure: lazily creates+memoizes iframe, waits ready handshake; cleared only by destroy() (the timeout recovery + only reset for cross-job contamination).
run timeout handler: destroy()s the iframe because a runaway loop can't be interrupted otherwise — intended runaway-loop mechanism.
main.ts listener: entire sandbox runtime; replies to ev.source because the opaque origin has no addressable target string.
buildScriptBrowseQuery: encoded query for browsing script tables, deterministic ORDERBYname.

unclear_code.note: Whether omitting ev.origin/source checks is deliberate (only host holds the iframe ref) or oversight; hardening must not break the pop-out full-page runner ('3+1' UX).

Whether design accepts scripts-under-test reaching fetch/DOM ('sandbox'=='no GlideRecord writes' not 'full containment'). Should be stated explicitly vs handoff 'Zero writes. Ever.' RESOLVED severity via orchestrator adjudication above.
RESOLVED: confirmed at manifest.config.ts:55 — no connect-src; fix lives there.
